contexts.text: A noble vine () = the man of the Spiritual Church.
The noble vine () = the Intellectual which is of the Celestial Church.
(These nuts) are of a less noble tree, and the things which are exterior are signified by such things as are less noble...
Those who love to serve without recompense... are preferred to more noble uses...
Something here concerning the noble (or notable) English nation.
The Church is noble if in genuine truths, ignoble if not...
The Word is held holy by a noble (or notable) nation among the Papists. (This statement is omitted in TCR 270.)
This noble nation (which holds the Word holy) is the French nation. AR 745:2.
They compared (it) to noble fruit...
As the love is then ennobled, it remains in its strength...
From the ennobling of this form are born noble fruits...
In this Hell there are many of noble descent...
Hence this noble (or notable) nation (the Germans) devote themselves little to things of judgment...
Concerning a noble offspring of the Most Ancient Church. SE 4068.
By the noble man () is meant the Lord.
The purest sap, which is also nobler, for the fruits...
Aliments of such diverse purity and nobility.
In the deserts and Hells I have seen many of noble descent who in the world had given themselves up to idleness...
In those caverns there are noble wives, nay, those of such men as had been of the first nobility; but all there are driven to labours...
Harlots of noble family... are cast into the marshy lake...
